P-mail (Printed Matter) The service rate is 200yen per mail, and 90yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 200yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 90yen
P-mail (Small Packets) The service rate is 650yen per mail, and 100yen per 100g of total weight.
Service rate = Total number of mails x 650yen + Total weight (unit of 100g) x 100yen
